book.name: MULUM PASA
book.title: MULUM PASA Kuate tuku mulum pasa Mosesŋge kuyarna

content: Kule suŋgo ta ibeŋ kina
Kuate nu Noa nane agaŋmor ndoŋ waŋ sinam taŋge minnaig ta nu sina so ndana. Nu nane idusniŋmba minna sulumba bubre sakina le pinderka kule muku serna.
Taŋamba nu kilke mbolŋge kule bulbulnaig ta mata tukulniŋgina sulumba samba mata tukulna le sawe ta kugana.
Tambun 5 ta sinamŋge kule ta ibeŋ-ibeŋmba minna.
Taŋamba minna ka ka tambun 7 ait 17 mbolŋge waŋ ta ndeka Ararat biŋ mbol taŋge minyokina.
Kule ibeŋ-ibeŋmba minna le tambun 10 ait 1 mbolŋge biŋ funu afu mayok kinaig.
Mara 40 kinaig le Noa nu bubre malaŋga fudiŋndo ta talka
kal ande kukulna le nu kule parakuwa ŋga ta tairŋga kine promba minmba luka pro ndana.
Taŋana le Noa nu kilke buk parakina e ŋga idusna sulumba gami ande kukulna le kina
kumba ka kule ndo minna le tiŋga mabtam tuku ma kugatok le nu maŋ luka waŋ tugum ta prona. Prona le Noa ndek wai kuitka tumba waŋ sinamŋge pilna.
Minna ma ma kusem ndindo kina le nu gami ta maŋ kukulna le kina
kumba ka furiram maŋ luka olif waŋenu abonu purmba tina ta nzoŋga tumba luka nu tugum ta prona. Taŋana le Noa nu ail waŋe ta kaŋgermba kule buk ibeŋ ket ŋga idusna.
Minna ma ma maŋ kusem ande kugana le maŋ gami ta kukulna le kina sulumba maŋ luka pro ndana. Nu nduiye kina.
Noa tuku yar 601 tambun ndindo ait ndindo mbolŋge kule kilke mbolŋge ta parakina le Noa nu wande funu buromba burok tambi mambilmba kilke kaŋgerna ta parakina.
Tambun arnu ait 27 mbolŋge kilke paraka kareŋgina.
Kile Kuate nu Noa sana:
Ne, piyo naŋe, kiŋo kat naŋe rugan kat naŋe tane ŋakmba waŋ mbolŋge mayok ka ibeŋ kape.
Agaŋmor ŋakmba tane ndoŋ minig ta sar umaŋ turmba ŋakmba kilmba kile-ibeŋkap. Taŋawap le nane tugeka kilke ŋakmba kumuŋge likamŋgaig ŋgina.
Taŋakina le Noa, nuŋe kiŋo kat nuŋe, piyo nuŋe, rugan kat nuŋe nane ŋakmba ibeŋ kinaig.
Sar umaŋ agaŋmor ŋakmba kilke mbolŋge likinaig tuku ta nyu mindek nane mata ibeŋ kinaig.
Noa nu Suŋgo tuku atraukina

Ibeŋ kinaig le Noa nu Suŋgo tuku idusmba ndame afu kilmba atraukam tuku pa laŋlaŋ wakeina. Wakeina sulumba sar umaŋ agaŋmor nyam tuku ndui ndui kilmba bale farmba pa laŋlaŋ ta mbolŋge patika Suŋgo atraukam tuku pasokina le ugmba usarkinaig.

Usarkinaig le Suŋgo nu mundur mayenu ta kamusna sulumba nu garena le wamdusmbi sakina: Taŋgo pino nane maŋ mbarwaig ta ye kilke te maŋ ŋayo siliwe nda. Nane kiŋo ndo wamdus ŋaigonu ŋak sugoka taŋamba ndo minig. Ye buk agaŋ abo minnaig tuku ta ŋakmba kile-ŋgisike suluwen ta ye maŋ taŋawe nda.

Kilke te minwa le nyamagaŋ ŋgunu tuku ait, nyamagaŋ mayekam tuku ait, sawe tuku ait, ki tuku ait, mafeŋ tuku ait, furir tuku ait ta ŋakmba kugawe nda. Mara mindek muŋgu dubika minmba minamŋgaig ŋgina.
